video_caption: The video begins with an aerial shot of a large, majestic stone castle at sunrise or sunset, with a prominent golden 3D box overlaid that reads "LMT ROYAL BOX." The scene then transitions to a group of four people standing on a white balcony or porch, including Prince Harry on the right, Meghan Markle holding baby Archie in the center, and Archbishop Desmond Tutu, who is waving, next to a woman in a black headscar. Both Harry and Meghan are smiling broadly. The next shot is a close-up of Meghan Markle holding a smiling baby Archie, with Prince Harry's shoulder visible to her left, and a partially transparent Union Jack flag is overlaid on the lower left of the screen. The final shot in this segment shows Prince Harry walking through a crowd of people, many of whom are smiling and waving small Union Jack flags, some of the crowd appear to be children in school uniforms, and a large Union Jack flag is held in the foreground on the left.

The video opens with a close-up shot of Queen Elizabeth II, dressed in a vibrant purple coat and matching hat, walking with a serious expression, accompanied by several people in ceremonial attire. A text overlay reads: "ARCHIE'S BIRTHDAY WILL BE CELEBRATED IN SCOTLAND WITH QUEEN." This text remains on screen as the scene transitions to a close-up of a baby's face, presumably Archie, looking off to the side with wide eyes. Next, a horse-drawn carriage, carrying individuals in formal wear, proceeds along a paved path in front of a grand stone castle, followed by a wider shot of the castle's imposing towers. The text overlay then briefly shows "US WEEKLY" and "AN INSIDER" before displaying: "The Sussexes have plans to go to Balmoral Castle in Scotland to celebrate with Queen Elizabeth." This is accompanied by an aerial view of Balmoral Castle surrounded by lush green hills. The next shot shows a person's hands gently holding a swaddled baby, again with the "US WEEKLY" and "AN INSIDER" text, followed by: "They have reportedly also 'talked to the queen about having a picnic on the grounds' of the estate." The camera then returns to Queen Elizabeth II, now seated, wearing a lime green suit, a pearl necklace, and a pale yellow hat with purple feathers, looking solemn. A night scene follows, showing Prince Harry and Meghan Markle exiting a dark blue Range Rover onto a red carpet, with other well-dressed individuals around them, then a shot of the Union Jack flag flying among palm trees. This is followed by an indoor scene where Meghan Markle, in a white coat and matching hat, smiles as she looks at Prince Harry, who is facing away from the camera. The video then transitions to older footage, first showing Prince Charles in a kilt and a young boy in a white top and green wellington boots fishing by a stream. A text box with "INSIDER" and a quote appears: "Archie loves being outside, and you can already tell he's inherited Prince Charles' passion for nature." This quote continues over a scene of Prince Charles, wearing a tweed jacket and boots, walking outdoors with two young boys, all dressed in similar countryside attire, possibly hunting or fishing. The older footage then splits into two frames, showing more of Prince Charles with a young boy in outdoor settings, reiterating the insider quote. The video concludes with a close-up of Meghan Markle smiling warmly while holding baby Archie, who is wearing striped overalls and a white long-sleeved shirt, looking contentedly off-camera.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a smiling Meghan Markle holding baby Archie, who is wearing a white long-sleeve shirt and striped overalls, while Prince Harry watches them, with a text overlay "ARCHIE WILL ALSO HAVE A SECOND CELEBRATION IN NORTH AMERICA" (Archie will also have a second celebration in North America). This scene transitions to various views of Los Angeles, including a street with palm trees and buildings, an elevated city view, and a wide shot of the Hollywood sign in the distance with the California flag waving, all accompanied by the same text overlay and a "ROYAL BOX" logo in the top left corner. Following this, an airport check-in area is shown, where a woman resembling Doria Ragland, Meghan's mother, in a white shirt and grey pants, pushes luggage past counters. The scene then shifts to three women leaving a building, with one in a grey plaid coat and black pants leading the way, suggesting Meghan's friends Jessica Mulroney and Abigail Spencer. Night-time shots of "PACIFIC'S CINEFAMA THEATRE" and "Nickelodeon on Sunset" are shown, followed by an aerial view of a bustling city skyline and finally a panoramic shot of a sunny beach with many people and coastal houses, all with the "ROYAL BOX" logo.

The video montage opens with Prince Harry, in a dark suit, and Meghan Markle, in a patterned top, looking at their baby, Archie, who wears a white onesie and is held by Meghan. An orange banner appears with the text "ARCHIE WILL REPORTEDLY GET SOME EXCITING GIFTS FOR HIS BIRTHDAY." This transitions to a formal royal family portrait in a grand room with green walls, followed by a black-and-white photo of Meghan kissing Archie while Harry looks on, and then another black-and-white photo of Prince Charles smiling at Harry, who is holding Archie. The next scene shows Harry and Meghan, both in dark clothing, holding a baby Yankees jersey with "ARCHIE 19" while surrounded by smiling baseball players in a room with a large Yankees logo. The video then focuses on a light green book titled "The Giving Tree by Shel Silverstein" lying on a white textured surface, followed by hands opening the book to its title page and a dedication page that reads "For Nicky." The screen briefly darkens before showing Queen Elizabeth II, wearing a blue-green dress and pearl necklace, seated at a wooden desk in a festive room with a decorated Christmas tree and a fireplace, with a banner stating "Queen Elizabeth WILL ALLEGEDLY GIVE ARCHIE A ROCKING HORSE." This is followed by an archival photo of a young Prince Harry, with light red hair, wearing a checkered shirt and blue overalls, sitting on a dark wooden rocking horse with colorful painted details, in a child's room. The next scene features Meghan Markle, in a white top, smiling while seated at a table next to a metal cart filled with trays of cupcakes, in what appears to be an outdoor tent. The video then shows a smiling Prince Harry in a suit and tie, with a banner that changes from "SECOND" to "WILL PRINCE HARRY AND MEGHAN MARKLE HAVE A SECOND CHILD?", as he stands in a grand room. This text remains as Harry, dressed in a light grey quarter-zip top, is seen talking to a person with camera crew behind him in an outdoor setting with brick buildings. Finally, the video ends with Prince Harry in a suit, shrugging with both hands raised, against a red patterned background, with the same text banner displayed.

The video opens with Prince Harry, wearing a grey shirt, sitting in an audience setting, possibly at an indoor event, holding a striped box of popcorn. A young blonde girl in a yellow floral top, seated next to him, looks intently at the popcorn and reaches out as Harry takes a piece to eat. A woman sits behind the girl, and another person in a white shirt and lanyard is visible behind Harry. The scene transitions to a formal event where Meghan Markle, with her dark hair pulled back and wearing a black dress, smiles at an older man in a dark suit while Prince Harry, also in a dark suit with a poppy pin, looks at Meghan and smiles. An on-screen text overlay with an "INSIDER" icon reads: "Prince Harry and Meghan might "start trying in earnest pretty soon" to conceive a second baby." This text remains as the video cuts to a close-up of Meghan, smiling, holding baby Archie, who has a bald head and is wearing a light-colored outfit. The next scene shows a person in a white lab coat and orange gloves working in a laboratory, handling small containers and then a machine with multiple pipettes dispensing liquid into a multi-well plate, with an "ITVNEWS" logo appearing in the top right corner. The video then transitions to a press conference where Dr. Bonnie Henry, identified by an on-screen lower third as "Dr. Bonnie Henry B.C. Provincial Health Officer," speaks at a podium with "Working for You" and "Global News" logos. A man in a suit and glasses stands beside her, and the background features a distinctive Vancouver skyline. Finally, the video returns to Meghan Markle holding baby Archie, both smiling, with Prince Harry looking at them fondly. The segment concludes with a shot of Meghan Markle, wearing blue aviator sunglasses, a striped shirt, and a navy jacket, smiling and posing outdoors with her hair blowing in the wind. Throughout the video, "THE ROYAL BOX" logo is consistently displayed in the top left corner.

The video opens with Meghan Markle, wearing a red dress and holding a red clutch, smiling as she walks indoors, with a man in a red military uniform visible behind her. The scene then transitions to Meghan Markle in a white wedding gown, veil, and tiara, seated and holding hands with Prince Harry, who is in a military uniform, both appearing solemn inside a grand church or cathedral. A yellow and black "ROYAL BOX" logo is present in the top-left corner of the screen throughout this segment.

The video opens with an outdoor scene featuring Queen Elizabeth II in a bright green coat and hat, and Meghan Markle in a cream-colored dress, both bending down to speak with two young children. Prince Harry, in a military uniform, stands behind Meghan, smiling, while other adults are also present in the background on what appears to be a grassy field. The wind gently blows the children's clothes and Meghan's hair as she gestures towards the child. A blue and yellow logo with the text "THE ROYAL BOX" (English) is visible in the top left corner of the screen throughout the video. The scene transitions to an evening shot of several people, including Meghan and Harry who are less clearly visible due to distance, entering a building with bright lights on a city street. The video then shows Meghan Markle standing at a podium inside a hall, wearing a floral dress and multiple leis around her neck, speaking into a microphone with a smile. She makes a small gesture with her hands as she speaks, with other individuals and a Union Jack flag visible in the background. This is followed by a shot of Prince Harry, in a denim shirt, and Meghan Markle, in a grey blazer, smiling and clapping while looking upwards, appearing to be part of an audience. The video concludes with a nighttime street scene in Los Angeles, featuring a red double-decker "Starline City Sightseeing" bus driving past illuminated buildings. Text visible on the buildings includes "THE HOLLYWOODLAND EXPERIENCE" (English), "AMOEBA MUSIC" (English) with "CDs · LPs · DVDs · VIDEO" (English) listed below it, "DISNEY STORE" (English), and "GHIRARDELLI" (English). Cars drive along the street, and the overall impression is a bustling urban environment at night.

The video showcases Meghan Markle in various stages of her public life, beginning with a close-up of her smiling brightly and touching her dark hair, with the text "THE ROYAL BOX" prominently displayed in the top left corner. This transitions to an outdoor scene where Meghan, dressed in a white shirt and black pants, smiles and poses with a group of diverse women, all in black business attire, against a backdrop of greenery and modern architecture, accompanied by the "Global News" logo. The narrative then shifts to highlight her independence, showing her in a red dress alongside Prince Harry in a military uniform on a dark stage, followed by clips of her as an actress in a light blue top and a white robe, and an outdoor event with Prince Harry where both wear sunglasses, with the text overlay "MEGHAN MARKLE WAS CALLED TOO INDEPENDENT By Royal Experts" (meaning royal commentators viewed her as overly self-reliant). Prince Harry is then shown speaking in an interview, with "ABC NEWS EXCLUSIVE" and "GMA" logos. Next, Meghan appears in a white wedding gown with Prince Harry and a priest inside a grand church, followed by a wide shot of her walking down the aisle in the same elaborate setting. She and Prince Harry are seen waving and smiling outdoors, with green grass in the background. The video then features Meghan in a colorful striped top, pink pleated skirt, and sunglasses, walking on a street with a reddish-brown building, under the "ROYAL BOX THE TIG" (referring to her former lifestyle brand) overlay. This is followed by close-ups of her speaking and with a serious expression, still linked to "THE TIG." She is then shown in a white coat and hat, looking down, surrounded by a crowd of photographers. The video circles back to her independent nature, showing her walking with Prince Harry and a security team in a public area, with text stating, "AN INSIDER Even though Meghan was a famous actress, she could still do what she wanted in the way of getting around freely" (referring to her freedom of movement before joining the royal family). The segment concludes with Meghan in a beige trench coat, engaging with fans and shaking hands, with additional text from the insider: "But in her current role she can't go anywhere without her protection team, and that's a massive constraining force on an individual like her" (indicating the restrictions on her personal freedom due to royal security protocols).

The video features various clips of Meghan Markle and Prince Harry, often accompanied by text overlays and a logo reading "BBC THE ROYAL BOX". It opens with a close-up of Meghan Markle looking to her left, followed by a scene of Kate Middleton and Prince William outdoors. Subsequently, Meghan Markle is seen walking down a church aisle in a wedding gown with Prince Charles, then holding hands with Prince Harry at an indoor event, and later walking down steps outdoors with him. A segment shows Meghan Markle posing on a red carpet for an "ELLE" and "OLAY AGELESS" event, where a quote from "DUNCAN LARCOMBE" appears: "As an actress, Meghan expects perfection. But when you're in the royal family, you have to learn that it's not about you, it's about what you represent." (This refers to Meghan's expected transition from an actress to a royal, implying a shift from individual focus to representing the monarchy). This is followed by close-ups of Meghan smiling. Newspaper headlines proclaiming "HARRY & MEGHAN QUIT WE'RE OUT..." and "...but we'll keep the titles, the house and the £650k security" are displayed, with a side headline "RIFT OVER SHOCK REVIEW". Meghan and Harry are then shown at an event, and Meghan states, "It's not enough just to survive something, right? That's not the point of life" (Meghan Markle's statement about seeking more than just survival in her life). The video shows an Instagram post from "sussexroyal" with Meghan and Harry walking, featuring a highlighted phrase "We intend to step back" (Their announcement of stepping back as senior royals). The post's caption explains their decision to carve out a progressive new role and become financially independent while balancing time between the UK and North America. The video concludes with Meghan Markle speaking, wearing a dark top, against a blurred background with a painting of a woman in a green top.

The video opens with a close-up of Meghan Markle smiling broadly, seen from the side with her hair pulled back and wearing a distinctive dangling earring. This transitions to a shot of her lower body, where she is seated, wearing dark pants and light-colored pointed-toe high heels, with her hands resting on a light-colored clutch bag. The final shot is a wider view of Meghan Markle, seated outdoors, wearing a white top, dark pants, and a light grey checkered jacket draped over her shoulders. She has a watch and bracelet on her left wrist, and her hands remain on the clutch bag as she looks downwards. The outdoor setting includes a green table and wooden planters with green foliage in the background. Throughout the clips, a text overlay at the bottom reads "MEGHAN MARKLE IS VERY DOWN TO EARTH," implying that despite her royal status, she possesses a humble and practical nature. The "THE ROYAL BOX" logo is consistently displayed in the top left corner of the frame.

The video opens with a blurry, close-up shot of a smiling Meghan Markle, which quickly sharpens to reveal an Instagram post from "skinesis" (Sarah Chapman). The post features a clear, smiling photo of Meghan Markle with her hair in an updo, wearing a dark top, with an Instagram caption detailing Sarah Chapman's appreciation for her relationship with "the Duke and Duchess of Sussex," stating it evolved from a client relationship into a "dear friendship." The text “LIVE ROYAL BOX” is visible in the top left corner of the screen throughout the video. The scene then transitions to a website or advertisement for "SARAH CHAPMAN London," displaying the text "Achieve professional results —from home—" and a "SHOP NOW" button, alongside various skincare tools. An inset image on the left shows three women, one of whom appears to be Meghan Markle wearing a white jacket and hat, sitting and smiling. The video then cuts back to the Instagram post from "skinesis," this time featuring a photo of Meghan Markle smiling on her wedding day, wearing a white dress, tiara, and veil, with the same caption visible.

The video segment features a series of close-up portraits of Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, on the left side of the screen, while an Instagram post remains static on the right. In the upper left corner, a yellow and black logo reads "LIVE ROYAL BOX". Meghan Markle's images transition subtly throughout the segment. At the beginning (0:04-0:10), she is seen smiling, wearing a vibrant green outfit and a matching green fascinator with netting, her hair styled up. This transitions to an image (0:10-0:19) where she wears a bright blue top with a high neckline, and her hair is pulled back in a sleek low ponytail, again with a warm smile. Finally, from 0:19 to 0:23, she is shown in a white collared shirt, open at the neck, with her hair in a similar sleek ponytail and a bright, open smile. The Instagram post on the right is from an account named "skinesis" (verified) and includes a lengthy caption. The caption reads: "Through my work I am fortunate to meet some incredible, interesting and inspirational people and over the past 2 1/2 years I feel honoured to have spent much time with the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. With Meghan, what began as a client relationship quickly turned into a dear friendship and she welcomed me into their lives. I feel very grateful to be a small part of their journey observing the passion for everything they do and compassion for the causes and people they meet, but also to witness the moments other people don't see. Who they are at home, as parents, as partners, and friends, the kind and very down to earth people they are when no one is watching. Every day..." Below the caption, it shows "3,114 likes" and "4 days ago," along with icons for liking, commenting, sharing, and saving the post. The text expresses gratitude for working with and knowing the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, particularly highlighting Meghan's kindness and passion.

The video opens with a close-up still image of Meghan Markle, smiling faintly with her hair pulled back and wearing a white collared shirt, positioned next to an Instagram post from "skinesis" (with text "Through my work I am fortunate to meet some incredible, interesting and inspirational people and over the past 2 1/2 years I feel honoured to have spent much time with the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. With Meghan, what began as a client relationship quickly turned into a dear friendship and she welcomed me into their lives. I feel very grateful to be a small part of their journey observing the passion for everything they do and compassion for the causes and people they meet, but also to witness the moments other people don't see. Who they are at home, as parents, as partners, and friends, the kind and very down to earth people they are when no one is watching. Every day...") that has 3,114 likes. This transitions to Prince Harry, dressed in a grey suit and holding a microphone, standing on a stage with a dark background featuring blue and white light patterns, while Meghan Markle, in a dark blue outfit, waves enthusiastically beside him. Next, Prince Harry in a dark suit and Meghan Markle in a dark green dress are seated on a light-colored couch, both looking towards the right side of the frame with thoughtful expressions. This is followed by a shot of Meghan Markle in a white wedding gown, holding a bouquet and arm-in-arm with Prince Harry in a dark military uniform, walking down an aisle adorned with abundant white and green floral arrangements, surrounded by wedding guests. The scene changes to Meghan Markle holding a baby (presumably Archie) while Prince Harry, standing next to her, smiles as the baby interacts with an older man, Desmond Tutu, who is also smiling, in a bright room with a "Desmond Legacy" sign visible in the background. Then, Prince Harry, in a blue blazer and white shirt, is seen smiling and laughing while talking to a man with grey hair in a suit, in what appears to be an indoor event. The video then displays an animated blue background with multiple "Subscribe" texts floating around, with a central "Subscribe" button highlighted. This transitions to an animated blue background with "Like" texts, and then to one with "Comment" texts, followed by an animated blue background with "PLEASE!" texts. The video concludes with a black and grey patterned frame on a white background, with "VIDEOS" in white text at the top and "FOR YOU" in yellow text on the left side, indicating suggestions for more content.
